objective: Build and dogfood a safe, resumable, recursively self-improving harness for autonomous engineering.

work_items.objective: Implement the local reconciled control loop with durable state, fenced leases, isolated worktrees, verification gates, and fast-forward promotion.
acceptance: A stale lease generation cannot change current run state.
Dispatch stops if the SPEC revision or base commit changed.
Promotion stops if a gate fails or the base commit changed.
Restart recovery preserves nonterminal evidence.
Lifecycle and security-negative tests pass.

work_items.objective: Use autobuild to propose, evaluate, and promote one measurable improvement to autobuild itself.
acceptance: The candidate runs in an isolated worktree.
The candidate passes all baseline gates.
The evaluation records a measurable non-regression or improvement.
Promotion is fast-forward only and leaves durable evidence.

work_items.objective: Stop active child processes promptly when the run loses desired-state or source authority.
acceptance: Each child-process heartbeat revalidates the full SPEC digest, base commit, lease generation, and lease time.
A SPEC or base-commit change stops the child process and makes the run stale.
An authority-loss event records a bounded durable cause.
No candidate is evaluated or promoted after authority loss.
Lifecycle and failure-injection tests pass.

work_items.objective: Fence concurrent controllers that use the same state database and base repository.
acceptance: A renewable controller lease has one current owner for each state database and base repository.
A second controller cannot dispatch or promote while the current owner remains valid.
A controller restart can recover after the ownership lease expires.
Read-only validation and status inspection do not require controller ownership.
Concurrency and recovery tests pass.

work_items.objective: Evaluate a bounded set of self-improvement candidates and select one with deterministic quality evidence.
acceptance: Configuration bounds the number and duration of candidate experiments.
Each candidate has isolated source state, gate results, and a deterministic score.
Only an all-pass non-regressing candidate can win.
A deterministic tie-break selects at most one candidate for promotion.
The state store preserves candidate rankings and the promotion decision.

work_items.objective: Rank eligible self-improvement candidates with deterministic Git change-surface evidence.
acceptance: The controller measures committed changed files, insertions, deletions, and total changed lines against the claimed base.
All verification gates and non-regression requirements remain mandatory.
Eligible candidates rank by fewer changed lines, then fewer changed files, then ascending candidate ID.
SQLite verifies and preserves each quality vector, deterministic rank, and promotion decision.
Failure-injection tests prove metric tampering, unequal quality, and exact tie behavior.

work_items.objective: Reconcile a local Git promotion that completed before its SQLite success state was finalized.
acceptance: The controller stores an immutable promotion intent with the run, expected base, candidate commit, worktree, and SPEC authority before fast-forwarding Git.
A replacement controller finalizes an interrupted run exactly once when the base repository is already at the intended candidate commit and authority is still current.
A crash before Git changes the base leaves the run retryable and preserves its worktree; an unrelated base commit prevents recovery and is never overwritten.
Recovery repairs the work-item achievement and self-improvement promotion decision without accepting a stale controller mutation.
Failure-injection tests prove the before-Git, after-Git, post-success, divergence, stale-authority, and idempotent-restart cases.
